AN18.question: Give two short trials to see whether my right ring finger stays in contact with the same sticker until a slow B turn stops. Use title: seconds headings and fit both into 60 seconds. Then in its own paragraph write one sentence asking Mel to film the trials tomorrow.

Hold the cube with your right ring finger resting on a single sticker on the R face. Make one slow B turn, watching only that fingertip. Stop the turn and freeze for 3 seconds. Note whether the finger is still on the same sticker or has slid onto a different one.

**Trial 2 — 20 seconds**
Reset the cube and repeat with a slower B turn, keeping the finger relaxed rather than pressing. Again freeze at the stop and check the sticker under the fingertip. Compare with Trial 1.

**Debrief — 20 seconds**
Write down for each trial: same sticker (yes/no), and whether the finger drifted during the turn or only at the stop. Two clean yes/no answers are enough to see the pattern.
